slides.headline: CHATGPT JUST REUNITED A LONG-LOST FAMILY AFTER ONE MESSAGE ASKED IT TO FIND THE MOTHER THEY NEVER KNEW
'Why not give AI a shot?'
slides.body: After trying everything else, one family member typed a single question into ChatGPT: can you find the mother I never knew. The search worked — The Guardian reports the long-lost family is now reunited

slides.headline: AI finds what humans gave up on
slides.body: The same models that cracked a search a family had abandoned can dig through your records, contracts and customer data in minutes. Businesses handing AI their impossible problems are getting answers everyone else quit on

slides.headline: Follow for daily AI news
slides.body: Daily AI stories, tools and real-world wins — see them before your competitors do

caption:
Swipe to see how one message to ChatGPT ended a lifelong search — and what that same power does for a business 🧵

The prompt 'Can you find the mother I never knew?', the family that had already tried everything else before giving AI a shot, how the ChatGPT-assisted search led to a real reunion after every traditional route failed, and the business takeaway: AI can now crack the searches and data problems humans have given up on.

AI just crossed from novelty chatbot to solving problems people had abandoned for good. When a consumer tool reunites a family that professionals and databases couldn't, the same capability pointed at business data stops being optional.

Sources: The Guardian
